description:
Revoke a DID-LLM for good, signed by its owner: it cannot be undone. The DID-LLM, its
credential and its entitlements stop working forever. Without challenge_id and
signature: returns the message to sign. Sign it with the owner key or wallet it names,
then call again with did, challenge_id and signature. Only when the owner really wants
it ended (for example a key that leaked and no other owner to change to).

challenge_id.description: Leave empty to get the message to sign
challenge_id.title: Challenge Id

controller_type.description: Who signs: ed25519 (the key, by default) or eip155 (the wallet)
controller_type.title: Controller Type

did.description: The DID-LLM (did:web:...:agents:...) or its identity ID (dmd_identity_...)
did.title: Did

signature.description: Signature of the message, as for debitmydata_prove_wallet_control
signature.title: Signature

name: debitmydata_revoke_did
title: Revoke a DID-LLM for good
